mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_id_on_chain, o.seller_address, u.username as seller_name, o.amount, o.price, o.status, o.created_time, o.updated_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM energy_orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.seller_address = u.blockchain_address WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM energy_orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.seller_address = u.blockchain_address WHERE o.order_id_on_chain = #{orderIdOnChain}

SELECT FROM energy_orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.seller_address = u.blockchain_address WHERE o.seller_address = #{sellerAddress} ORDER BY o.created_time DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO energy_orders (order_id_on_chain, seller_address, amount, price, status, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{orderIdOnChain}, #{sellerAddress}, #{amount}, #{price}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE energy_orders SET order_id_on_chain = #{orderIdOnChain}, seller_address = #{sellerAddress}, amount = #{amount}, price = #{price}, status = #{status}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
